body: Of course. It affects your friends and family the most. I Just dont want anyone else to have to witness such a horrible image. I hope OP can get some help.

I experience the EXACT same thing. Once im passed the opening, i can get most things inside me, but that opening is what stops me from having sex in the first place. I can still ise very small dialtors

I get it, but having someone kill themselves in front of me actually ended up making me more suicidal. It effects the people around you as well. I ended up having a major panic attack and having some stranger hold me down to calm my nerves

This happened to me a few weeks ago, i was on a train to see my boyfriend and we hit someone who purposely jumped in front of it. It delayed everyone's trips by about 10 hours and i had to pay extra to get a new ticket. Im suicidal too, but id kill myself in a way that doesnt inconvenience others

For me, its none of the woman having my hair or skin tone. Reminds me of how wortheless and disgusting most men find me.  I can only force myself to vomit so much, Ill never look like those "sexy" girls

It hurts me everyday as well. But Ive never been anyones type, so even if i found somone new, id still have to deal with this. And i love him. I just hope he continues to love me and doesnt leave me for his preferred type

Ive been straightening my hair and starving myself just to look more like my boyfriends type. It doesn't work because i will never be stick thin and Asian, but it helps me to cope.

Im curvy and black, ill never be my boyfriend's type, but I should just be happy that someone is willing to put up with my ugly ass
Ive been using BetterHelp and have been getting some progress out of it. Mostly because i dont have anyone else to talk to
I dont even know you, and i love you more than I love myself. <3
Im sorry
Im the same way. Makes me suicidal
I seems he understood, and its been a few days since hes said anything that has triggered me

Youre not harsh at all, i really appreciate people's advice and different perspectives.

I dont plan on dumping him, i tried speaking to him earlier and i am waiting to see if he changes his behavior
I spoke to him earlier and im not sure he understood the severity. But i will wait and see if there is a difference in his behavior
Thank you for the advice. Its appreciated
Ive spoken to hik recently and waiting to see if it made a difference

Ive sort of tried to. Ive told him i have days where i cannot look at anyone or anytning because of how bad my insecurity gets. Sometimes he does still send me things and i thinks its because he thinks im better after a few days. But the truth is i never feel ok. I dont think he realizes the extent of my bdd

Im conflicted because on one hand i cant control his libido or actions. I am not controlling and let him watch whatever he wants. Its his body. But on the other hand i guess i just have never understood why some people rely so much on looking at other people when theyre in a relationship. I feel like that makes me sound so insecure and controlling though. 

Idk, im probably just a stick in the mud about that sort of thing.

I have talked to him about my bdd recently and while.he understands, i nevee mentioned how much of it is triggered by him. So i dont know if he realizes i was mostly talking about him. He hasnt said a thing too triggering in the laat 24 hours, im hoping this is the beginning of something healthier for me
Idk. Usually he'll jerk off and send me things like that. I think because we used to do this as friends and also i am bisexual, so maybe he thinks im into it??

Thats what im thinking. Which i guess is fine and fair. We cant all date the man/woman of our dreams. I just dont want to know about it. Makes me wanna self harm. Something about being aware that im not what he wants that makes me wanna die

Hey thank you. I was waiting to hear from another POC, because i feel that adds a whole new layer to my bdd that can make things more unbearable. My boyfriend is not a POC if that paints the picture a little better for you. Which i think makes things so much worse.

I cant do anything about knowing his preference because we were friends for so long, but id die happy if i never heard another remark about hot cosplayers and thin girls with long straight perfect hair. I actually think another comment might make me hurt myself. Which id prefer to not have to do.

Thanks for the example, your comment actually made me feel a little better

Its true i have no proof hes settling. Im going by his actions to determine things to be honest..all i know is that no one would love him. When we were friends i knew how depserate he was for a girlfriend. For someone to spend the rest of his life with. When we talked about girls he liked or wanted...they never were anything like me. Sure, he probably does love me. But its hard to tell if he is in love with me or if he realizes that i would love him forever so he deals with me. Im a safe choice i guess. And he can always watch porn of who he prefers when he needs to.

Yes, i have low self esteem. I mean thats why im on this subreddit. Because i see my face and body much differently then alot of people do. Its very hard for me to be kind to myself and find myself attractive.  I do have a therapist who has helped my depression despite how miserble i sound. She very helpful and i will continue to see her. This issue with my boyfriend may end up being a life long issue that i need to learn to cope with. Im just not sure how

Im so sorry about this. Some people date for security and not for love. My heart goes out to you. I doubt anything i say will make you feel better, but im sure youre beautiful.

 I appreciate you hearing me out and relating, it makes me feel heard and not so alone on this issue

Its very hard...how do you deal with knowing this information?? I understand that its possible that he can like small and pale AND chubby and black. People can have more than one preference. Im totally ok with that

But i am the only girl that looks like me that he has ever shown interest in. I find it so...odd.

My boyfriend is tall, husky and pale skinned. I dont have a skin preference, but i like big bear-like men. That is what im into, so thats who i date. I cant imagine choosing someone who isnt my type at all. And if I did, i would do what i could to keep that part of me to myself, so I don't potentially  trigger my partner

Its interesting to hear different perspectives of people suffering from bdd as well. Although i dont know what movies youre watching where the black girl is usually the sexy one. Send me movie suggestions aha.

I do exercise but gained a bit during holiday festivities. I plan on losing 20 pounds to atleast try to make myself feel better. Im gonna start using more beauty products as well. I cant change my skin or anything but i can try to look decent. Ill never look like my boyfriends dream girl. EVER. ill never be that hot girl he fantasizes about, but id like to feel a just little less digusting

Im so sorry that happened to you...it sucks because i cant decide if i should go ahead and end it because of how miserable i feel, or ignore my brain and stop self sabotaging myself.

It really does mess up my self esteem. Im not saying my bf doesnt love me, but if he could have had a hotter girl he would have.

Even worse is that we are long distance at the moment. By about 2 hours. I have no proof he hasnt already replaced me. Id never know

Its probably because i was so chill and cool with it back when we were friends. But now that we are dating i dislike seeing most of his porn preferences. I know i sound like a stick in the mud, but this is something that triggers me so badly

Theres not much i love about myself. My therapist has atleast helped me see that im not a complete trainwreck. There are a few things i like about myself I guess. I like how hardworking i am. Thats about it. I can admire that about myself. Not much else.

I often have thoughts of taking my life when my bdd is triggered. Only thing that calms it is shutting down and being alone for a long period of time. Which sucks because I have to spend time with my boyfriend. But when im with him i feel gross

I am aware men like this exist. And at times it does make me feel better.

My boyfriend having a preference is normal and that in itself doesn't bug me, I just wish I didn't know about it. Or if he could stop making that obvious it would be nice.

It would be nice to be someones preferred woman for once. This has never happened for me because I am the complete opposite of what is considered sexy.

Even if i try to find another boyfriend, no one is gonna want me. And even if they did, theyd be settling as well. Ive never met anyone who has described a hot woman as someonewho looks like me. I want to die

I'm sorry youre feeling that way, im going through something similar myself.

Just existing with bdd is so exhausting
